note: P4347 (Pro 29:14) — if a king faithfully judges the poor, his throne is established forever.

dims.v: just rule — the king who judges the poor truly, and so endures
the faithful, true judging of the poor by a king — the impartial justice to the weak that establishes a throne forever, governance measured by how it treats the powerless
the just care for the poor that founds a lasting reign

shaphat (judge) — 'if a king FAITHFULLY judges the poor, his throne will be established forever'; a reign is secured by justice to the weak, not power over them. Emergent: faithful judgement of the poor as the foundation of enduring rule (cf 16:12; 20:28; 29:4).
